behaviors.assignee-options: Opening the Assignee dropdown shows Anyone, each person, and Unassigned with task counts.
behaviors.search-people: Typing a name in Find a person narrows the dropdown options.
behaviors.combined-filters: With To do selected, choosing Priya shows only her To do task.
behaviors.unassigned-filter: Choosing Unassigned shows only tasks without an assignee.
behaviors.assignee-empty-state: Choosing Ana shows “Nothing assigned to Ana Lima yet” and a Clear filters control.
behaviors.clear-filters: Clear filters restores All statuses and Anyone, showing all four seed tasks.

history.notes: The toolbar scopes assignee choices away from matching names on task cards. This assumes the dropdown renders its choices inside the toolbar, as implied by the supplied app structure.
Dropdown options render in a popup outside the toolbar, so option locators use the open popup. The toolbar locator is used only for the selected Assignee value and Status control.
